scope: Synthetic isolated data only; no Production connection or deployment

results.test: Immediate discount, preview immutability and changed versus duplicate operation counts
Increasing decreasing and custom delayed stages use the immutable base and product floor
Prior Woo sales restore exactly and a manual external price is never overwritten
Overlapping draft priority grants one owner and never preempts an existing financial owner
Owned archive and copy are blocked; restored campaign copies and reruns without rewriting old history
Server-side scope crosses 200 products, resolves group floors and previews/removes without Woo price saves
Hourly queues recover delayed stages and one failed write uses bounded retry with precise reporting
REST converts one Persian Toman fixed amount into canonical IRR exactly once
Registered WooCommerce shipping tax fixture resolves a positive ten-percent rate
Ordinary and mixed carts cannot qualify using ordinary totals
At and above threshold customer pays only shipping above one cap
Shipping at or below cap becomes zero without negative tax
Zero threshold has no minimum but still requires a campaign quantity
Coupon, quantity and removal recalculate eligibility
Multiple packages share a single cart cap and alternative rates do not multiply it
Changing another package invalidates the first package allocation cache
Repeated rate filtering is idempotent and disabling restores original rate
Unknown package context, unsupported tax and unrounded base fail closed
Zero cap and unknown-currency default never invent a shipping discount
A changed store currency and external price edit are ineligible
WooCommerce session-rate cache cannot retain a full cap after package split
A deleted configured method cannot subsidize an externally retained rate
